name: Kusakabe Shizuku
source: Kiichi's stepsister with beautiful black hair[Spoiler], she's the true identity of "Cameo", the mysterious person who supported Kiichi's activities as a "Feeler" in the first game. An unlucky girl ravaged by a peculiar chronic disease whereby her skin will burn and bruise when touched. Her wish is to venture forth to the underground Chikan world, so once again she's working as Kiichi's right hand. She's the type who will do anything to achieve her goals, regardless of the consequences. Her range of hobbies is abnormally varied. [/Spoiler]
